status_of_seasons.current_already_looked_at: 2026/27 up to the data snapshot below (NOT a holdout)

selection_by_frozen_rule.rule: Среди всех вариантов (кроме базового) на универсуме site: минимум max(|gap 2023/24|, |gap 2024/25|); при равенстве — меньший log loss 2024/25. Перспективен, если 95 % ДИ gap содержит 0 в обоих сезонах отбора на обоих универсумах, а |gap| < |gap базового| в объединённых сезонах отбора (Holm p < 0.05).

why_these_hypotheses: On 2023/24-2025/26 every post-selection map removes the over-estimation of the chosen Main; on 2026/27 the maps fitted on walk-forward history do not transfer to production (gap of the shown Main +0.0490; after PS-Platt +0.0413), while the same map refitted month by month on production's own shown Mains gives -0.0086 and the group-wise history map gives -0.0085. Both observations were made on 2026/27 after looking at it; this file turns them into forward hypotheses.

H1_primary.name: PS-Platt по месяцам (на показанных Main продакшна)
H1_primary.rule: For a Main shown for a match in calendar month m: stated probability p' = sigmoid(a_m + b_m * logit(pc)), pc = probability / (1 - push_probability). (a_m, b_m) = logistic regression (sklearn, C = 1e4) of WON (1) / LOST (0) on logit(pc) over ALL settled shown Mains of the unified history of season 2026/27 (src.analytics.performance.unified_history, role main) whose match date is before the first day of month m. The pick itself is unchanged.

H2_challenger.name: PS-Group (карты по группам рынков, история 2022/23-2025/26)
H2_challenger.rule: p' = sigmoid(a_g + b_g * logit(pc)) with the frozen per-group parameters below (group of the Main; 'pool' for any other group). The pick itself is unchanged.

forward_test.window: matches played from the day after the commit of this file until the earlier of (a) 600 settled (WON/LOST) shown Mains or (b) the end of season 2026/27
forward_test.population: shown Main of every match of the unified history in the window (src.analytics.performance.unified_history, role main, status WON/LOST); refunds excluded as in production
forward_test.metric: gap = mean(p') - hit rate; raw gap = mean(pc) - hit rate; 2000 bootstrap resamples by match, seed 20261109
criteria: C1: the 95 % CI of gap(p') contains 0
C2: the paired 95 % CI of |gap(p')| - |gap(pc)| lies entirely below 0
C3: Holm correction over the two hypotheses (H1, H2) for C2 (p < 0.05 after correction)
forward_test.decision: A (adopt the stated-probability calibration of the shown Main, display only, picks unchanged) if C1-C3 hold for H1, else for H2; otherwise C. No change to the Main pick or to betting is implied: the ROI of the Main is not affected by either map.

not_registered: No ROI hypothesis: no Main rule improved ROI on both selection seasons with a Holm-corrected pooled test (selection.json, roi.promising = false).
